tools.name: list_open_work_orders
tools.description: Returns open work orders for a production line, newest first.

lineId.description: Production line identifier, for example LINE-04.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 25.

tools.name: get_machine_status
tools.description: Returns current status, last heartbeat and active downtime reason for one machine.

tools.description: Writes a shift handover note against a production line.

note.description: Free text handover note, 2000 characters maximum.
